name: page-timeline
description: Journey section of the 2026 company pages (Our Company, Figma 7385:186215): a sticky intro column (eyebrow, heading with a gradient phrase, lede) beside a timeline of milestones. Each milestone sits behind a left rule that deepens from indigo-200 to indigo-600 down the list and carries a year label, a heading, paragraphs, an optional small note and arrow links; an optional closing statement in gradient type ends the last milestone.

anchor.description: id on the section (letters, digits, hyphens).

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the heading.

title_accent.description: Words of the heading painted with the brand gradient (first occurrence); must appear in title.

lede.description: Copy under the heading. Blank line = new paragraph; [label](url) links, **bold**.

items.description: Milestones, top to bottom. Each: year (small label), title (h3), body (blank line = new paragraph; [label](url), **bold**), optional note (small print under the body; [label](url) links), optional links [{ label, url }] (arrow links in a row).

closing_lead.description: Bold upper-case line that opens the closing statement inside the last milestone.

closing_text.description: Closing statement in large gradient type under closing_lead.

look.description: journey: Our Company's milestones (year label over the heading; rules indigo-200 to -600). steps: numbered steps (Our Technology, Figma 7460:109053): each item's year is drawn as a large thin number beside its heading, and the number and rule cycle indigo, pink, green, amber, blue.

cta_label.description: Gradient button under the intro lede. Renders only with cta_url.

cta_url.description: Button destination (a page, #anchor, http(s) or mailto:).
